# The £6 a week homeworking relief has ended. What can you still claim back?

> Free UK calculator: the £6 a week working from home tax relief ended in April 2026, but 2022/23 to 2025/26 can still be claimed. See your refund per year and each deadline. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
